explication: Revive is a configurable Go source-code linter and extensible linting library. Its main workflow is: a user invokes the CLI with paths and options; configuration selects and configures rules and an output formatter; the runner discovers packages and delegates file analysis to the linter; rules report failures; and the selected formatter renders them for the user. The README also documents comment-based suppression, optional type checking, custom rules and formatters, and configurable exit codes. Some of those implementation details are unsampled, so documented links are shown without implying uninspected internals.
